paragraphs.source_en: From **Jim Wiandt**, founder of ETF.com (ironically, formerly named IndexUniverse.com): “I have always found it ironic that indexing—like almost everything else in the world of finance—comes in waves. Hedge fund indexes, microcap indexes, dividend indexes, commodities indexes, China indexes, and ‘enhanced’ indexes are all flavors of the month. And I’ll give you three guesses as to what all these indexes have in common: (1) chasing returns, (2) chasing returns, or (3) chasing returns.
